MultiID-Bench in WithAnyone
	







The MultiID-Bench dataset is a benchmark introduced in the paper WithAnyone: Towards Controllable and ID Consistent Image Generation. It is specifically tailored for multi-person scenarios in text-to-image research, providing diverse references for each identity. reputation: A niche but growing benchmark used by researchers working on controllable multi-person text-to-image generation (not yet widely adopted outside that subcommunity).
